title: Normalized ordinary scalar tensor comparison
statement: For a scheme W and a map of commutative ring sheaves φ : A → B on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let E be the specified scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] and r the specified restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There is a unique natural isomorphism E ⋙ r ≅ (− tensor_A r(B)) carrying the sheafification of b tensor x to x tensor b. The coefficient object and its degree-zero complex are the literal restriction of the B-module unit and its single complex. The resulting ordinaryComplexIso is the degreewise scalar comparison followed by the degree-zero second-factor tensor identification. All definitions and the uniqueness statement are unchanged from the ordinary part of lem-sfb-derived-scalar-tensor-identification.

proof.text: Construct the tensor-to-restricted-extension component by braiding the two factors, using the independently normalized extension/tensor comparison, and transporting along the specified object equality for scalar extension. On sectionwise pure tensors its map is precisely the sheafification of b tensor x. Naturality of the sheafification unit supplies the scalar-extension map formula. The tensor-generator extensionality principle reduces naturality and uniqueness to this pure-tensor formula. Invert the constructed natural isomorphism to obtain the required orientation. Extend it degreewise to cochain complexes and compose with the canonical single-factor tensor isomorphism.
